raw_text: Always start by reading [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md). Review domain docs before changes. Use owners/platform team for cross-cutting approvals. Record architecture decisions in `DECISIONS/` via ADR. Ownership: platform—`crates/rustok-core`, `apps/server`, shared infra; domains—`crates/rustok-*`; frontends—`apps/admin`, `apps/storefront`, `apps/next-admin`, `apps/next-frontend`; MCP—`crates/rustok-mcp`; tooling—`scripts/`, `docker-compose*.yml`, `grafana/`, `prometheus/`. See [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md). Central `docs/` is Russian; public contracts, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, crate `README.md` are English. Mixed language within a single document is not allowed — choose one language per file. Keep component docs and root READMEs (purpose, responsibilities, interactions, entry points, `docs/` link); `docs/modules/_index.md` links modules. For architecture/API/events/modules/tenancy/routing/UI/observability: update local docs, central docs, [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md), and registry for added/renamed components; mark outdated docs `deprecated`/`archived` with replacement. Do not create a new document when an existing one is suitable — extend it instead. Documentation must reflect the actual state of the code. Never bypass or disable pre-commit/pre-push hooks. Fix the root cause of failures. Do not edit CI/CD workflow files unless explicitly requested. Do not modify other branches — only work on the assigned task branch.
